maintenance_led.reason: Mostly home medical equipment rentals and recurring resupply of CPAP, ostomy and wound consumables, not repair or servicing of owned items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid largely by Medicare, Medicare Advantage and Medicaid for oxygen, CPAP, mobility and supplies, alongside commercial insurers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Built through many acquisitions of local home medical equipment providers; it is now divesting its diabetes business to Cardinal Health.

mission_critical.reason: Patients can move to another insurer-network home medical equipment supplier with a prescription; switching is a transfer, not a rebuild.

notes: Government share of revenue is estimated from memory; commercial insurers are also a large payer.
